name: browser-use
description: Real browser automation: navigate, click, type, screenshot — approval-gated.

commands.name: browse
commands.description: Open a page and work with it in the browser
commands.template: Open {input} in the browser with browser_go, take a screenshot, and complete the task with browser_click/browser_type - approval-gated.

commands.name: capture
commands.description: Capture visual evidence for a page
commands.template: Capture visual evidence for: {input}. Navigate, take a screenshot, record the URL and a short observation; do not submit a form.

commands.name: fill
commands.description: Fill a form with approval before submit
commands.template: Fill the form for: {input}. Show the exact fields and values, request approval before submit, and capture the result.

changelog: 1.1.0 - DoD pass: skill pack with two examples, commands, changelog and README entry.
